title: Defense-in-depth security checks at two distinct surfaces
context: Claim V-JOIN-SECRET-NONLEAK has a primary component test proving the secret is not rendered in the DOM. A separate concern: the secret must also never appear in a structured server log line, which the component test cannot observe at all.
request: Add a test asserting the join-secret allocation log entry never includes the raw secret value, only its allocation ID.

expected.rationale: This is legitimate defense-in-depth (TG-04 example: a genuinely different attack surface — structured logs, not the DOM). It is added as a secondary owner on the same claim with uniqueProof stating it covers the server log surface, which the existing component test cannot observe at all.
